== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[The Grand Inquisitor's Lightsaber]]: the PC card image of [[The Grand Inquisitor's Lightsaber]] (7 August 2025, [[:File:V25-D-thegrandinquisitorslightsaber.gif|V25-D-thegrandinquisitorslightsaber.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (page 6). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
